subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and what secret-bearing handoff is acceptable for callback or token material?
rationale: The request creates a new provider-auth and environment/config surface around OAuth authorization material, so automation cannot safely choose the security posture or public contract.

options.title: Design safer auth handoff
options.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow only after defining validation, redaction, storage, docs, and proof requirements for callback or token material.

options.title: Accept callback URL env
options.body: Support the proposed environment callback import with explicit PKCE/state validation, redaction, and CI/shell safety guidance.

options.title: Defer to existing flows
options.body: Keep API-key, browser/manual paste, and device-code as the supported setup surfaces until Codex exposes a safer stable contract.

recommendation.title: Design safer auth handoff
recommendation.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow only after defining validation, redaction, storage, docs, and proof requirements for callback or token material.

likelyOwner.reason: The non-interactive provider setup gate and provider onboarding-auth migration history make this account the clearest routing candidate for the product/security choice.
